method: Nine fresh processes per profile, persistent compile cache disabled. scope: Namespace imports without global installation. Official @js-temporal/polyfill 0.5.1 plus forced temporal-polyfill 1.0.7 full and basic implementations; full calendar comparison excludes basic and officialReference (documented ICU 78.2 incompatibility). TS default uses captured installed Intl for named timezones and Umm al-Qura, with compact owned Chinese/Dangi arithmetic/data. Standalone owns calendar packs and IANA histories. Both WASM profiles use Rust timezone data; native-data WASM drops duplicate TS packs while hybrid retains compact TS calendars. All matched outputs asserted. Diagnostic one-sample mode does not establish representative timings.
